gold_assessment.reasoning: Generated cc-001 includes dizziness and tinnitus; nausea also mentioned elsewhere. Although it adds spinning sensation and unsteady gait, the core complaint of dizziness is captured.
Gold: dizziness for the past few hours. Generated hpi-001: onset ~2 hours ago. Two hours is within 'past few hours', so this is captured, with more specific timing.
Gold: similar episode 1 month ago lasting 10 minutes. Generated hpi-002: similar episode about 1 month ago lasting 5–10 minutes. This includes the 10-minute duration and is consistent.
Gold: patient feels as though on a boat. No generated fact mentions a 'boat-like' sensation, only room-spinning/unsteadiness.
Gold: denies recent viral illness. Generated hpi-007 states no recent viral illness. Directly covered.
Gold: buzzing noise in ears (tinnitus). Generated hpi-009 and pe-003 state buzzing tinnitus/ear buzzing. Clearly captured.
Gold: denies hearing problems. Generated hpi-009 and pe-004: hearing intact aside from tinnitus. This expresses no hearing problems except tinnitus.
Gold: denies ear discharge. Generated hpi-008 and pe-003: no ear pain or discharge. Fully captured.
Gold: denies ear pain. Generated hpi-008 and pe-003: no ear pain or discharge. Fully captured.
Gold: feels nauseous but not been sick (no vomiting). Generated hpi-005: nausea present; no vomiting. Direct match.

Gold: denies weakness of the arms and legs. Generated pe-001: no focal weakness described. This is weaker and does not explicitly state absence of arm/leg weakness; could be interpreted as incomplete documentation rather than a direct denial. The specific arms/legs denial is not clearly captured.
Gold: premature ovarian failure. Generated pmh-001 and asm-003: premature ovarian failure on HRT. Core past medical history is captured.
Gold: takes HRT. Generated med-001 and med-002: patient is taking hormone replacement therapy, listed as current medication. Covered.
Gold: no known allergies. Generated allergy-001: allergies none. Directly covered.
Gold: most likely diagnosis is labyrinthitis. Generated asm-001: working diagnosis is labyrinthitis. Equivalent.

Gold: prescribe Stemetil 1 tablet TID ~10 days for symptom relief. Generated plan-001: Semitol 1 tablet PO TID for 10 days for symptomatic vestibular relief. Same dose/frequency/duration/intent; drug name spelling differs but clearly corresponds.
Gold: book face-to-face appointment to have ears checked. Generated plan-010 and fu-001: book with doctor for ear examination and further assessment. Equivalent instruction.

Gold: recommend physical check-up including BP and other basic assessments. Generated plan-007 and plan-008: BP measurement and gait/neurologic assessment during visit. These are basic physical assessments; the essence is covered though details are more explicit.

Gold: if weakness of arms/legs or vomiting develops, go to A&E. Generated plan-003 and plan-005: seek urgent care (A&E) for new/worsening unilateral weakness or violent vomiting. This captures the same escalation triggers, with added qualifiers but no conflict.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC only documents dizziness; nausea and tinnitus are in HPI, and unsteady gait & spinning sensation are not specified. Combining all into the chief complaint and adding unsteady gait/spinning is added detail beyond the gold chief complaint.
Gold: dizziness for the past few hours. ~2 hours fits within 'past few hours'; this is a more precise, consistent specification.
Gold: similar episode 1 month ago lasting 10 minutes. Generated: 5–10 minutes. Range includes 10 min, so it’s consistent, just more flexible.
Gold never mentions 'room-spinning' or continuity. Only dizziness/boat-like feeling are documented. Continuous, room-spinning vertigo is new detail.
Ability to walk but not straight/unsteadiness with gait is not described in gold facts. This is new information.
Gold: nauseous but not been sick. Generated: nausea present; no vomiting. Directly aligns.
Gold facts do not mention fever. Stating 'no fever' is a new negative finding.
Gold: no recent viral illness. Generated: no recent viral illness. Directly supported.
Gold: no ear discharge or ear pain. Generated matches this exactly.
Gold: buzzing noise in ears + separate denial of hearing problems. Generated: buzzing tinnitus with otherwise intact hearing. Combined but consistent with both hpi-005 and hpi-006.
Premature ovarian failure is exactly the same past medical history item.

Gold notes premature ovarian failure as PMH and HRT as medication, but does not state that this combo appears specifically as an assessment list item. The fact about how it is presented structurally is additional.
Gold: takes HRT. Generated: taking hormone replacement therapy. Same medication use.
Gold: HRT as a medication. Generated: HRT is a current medication. Consistent characterization.
Gold: no allergies. Generated: allergies none. Direct match.
Gold facts do not address social history at all. Declaring that social history is not documented is extra meta-documentation not present in gold.

Gold: denies weakness of arms and legs in HPI, but no gold physical exam details exist. 'No focal weakness described on neurologic assessment' refers to an exam section that is not in the gold facts, so this is new information.
Gold HPI describes dizziness and 'boat-like' sensation, not explicitly 'unsteadiness with spinning' in neurologic review. This phrasing and placement under PE is new detail.
Gold: buzzing in ears; denies ear pain/discharge. Generated: ear buzzing/tinnitus; no ear pain or discharge. Same substantive findings, though labeled under PE rather than HPI.
Gold: denies hearing problems. Generated: hearing intact aside from tinnitus. Equivalent content.
Gold does not mention presence or absence of fever. 'No fever' in objective section is extra information.
Gold does not discuss whether vital signs were documented. Stating that vitals are not documented is additional meta-documentation.
Both list labyrinthitis as the working/most likely diagnosis, with added descriptive symptoms in the generated fact that match HPI (vertigo, nausea, disequilibrium).

Gold: similar episode of dizziness one month ago. Generated: recurrent vertigo episode in the past month with similar presentation. Same clinical concept of recurrence; framing in assessment is additional but consistent.
Gold: premature ovarian failure and HRT use. Generated: premature ovarian failure on HRT listed in assessment. Content is the same; only the section placement is extra detail.
Gold only states no recent viral illness; it does not generalize to 'no acute infectious signs.' That summary is a broader inference and not explicitly in gold.

Gold: Stemetil 1 tab TID for ~10 days for symptom relief. Generated: Semitol 1 tab PO TID for 10 days for symptomatic vestibular relief. Same regimen and intent; drug name spelling differs but is consistent with the described gold plan.
Gold does not mention instructions about taking with or without food. This dosing flexibility is new counseling detail.

Gold follow-up red flag: any weakness of arms/legs and vomiting. Generated narrows to 'new or worsening unilateral weakness,' which is more specific and partially discordant in nuance. As gold does not specify laterality or progression, this is best treated as an added qualifier rather than direct contradiction.
Gold red flags do not mention severe new headache. Including headache as a reason for urgent care is new.
Gold mentions vomiting (no intensity qualifier). Generated: 'violent vomiting.' This adds a severity threshold not present in gold, so it’s an added nuance.

Gold: patient to book face-to-face appointment to have ears checked. Generated plan-006 says ENT/doctor will examine ears during the visit to confirm middle/inner ear status. The idea of a provider examining ears matches the intent but specifying ENT and middle/inner ear confirmation is additional; gold doesn’t explicitly say ENT or specify middle/inner ear.
Gold: physical check-up including blood pressure. Generated: BP measurement planned during the visit. BP component is directly supported.
Gold: physical check-up including BP and other basic assessments. Gait and neurologic assessment are reasonable examples of basic assessments and consistent with this.
Gold does not specify the pharmacy or that a prescription was sent to Lloyd Pharmacy. Naming the pharmacy is new logistical detail.
Gold: book face-to-face appointment to have ears checked. Generated: book with doctor for ear examination and further assessment. Same substantive instruction.
Gold says 'you will need to book' but does not specify calling support. 'Call support to book' is extra process detail.
Gold plan does not explicitly say the patient was reassured that treatment is symptomatic management, though this is consistent with the plan. This reassurance is new counseling content.
Gold follow-up identifies specific red flags but does not state generally 'monitor for red flag symptoms.' That generalized instruction is additional framing.
Gold only states a face-to-face appointment to have ears checked, without specifying otolaryngology referral. 'Arrange otolaryngology evaluation' is extra, specialist-level planning.
Same instruction as gold plan-002 (book with doctor for ear exam and further assessment); just placed in follow-up section.
Gold does not say to 'call support' to book; that logistical detail is new.
